title: Clementine mission as photo reconnaissance for moon bases

tellings.quote: Brandenburgg says that the Clementine mission was basically a photo reconnaissance mission to see if someone was building bases on the moon that we didn't know about and were they expanding them.

plain: The claim is that Clementine, a 1994 mission that sent a spacecraft to photograph the moon, was really a spy-photo mission to check whether someone was building bases on the moon that the US didn't know about, and whether they were growing. A guest named Maaneli Derakhshani passes this on from a man named John Brandenburg, alongside a book called Aliens on the Moon: The Truth Exposed. If true, the US suspected someone else was already building on the moon.
